result.reason: The operative language does not reach the playbook position. It grants the Company a 30-day convenience-termination right without a fee, but it omits the required pro-rata refund of prepaid fees. It also leaves subsection (a) intact, creating a direct conflict because that subsection requires a Termination Payment whenever the Company terminates. Further, HDI retains an apparent right to terminate on 90 days' notice without being limited to the end of a committed term. The added 'in whole or in part' right is also broader than necessary. The margin comment cannot cure these defects.
